# Template block

Contributed by the `web` template as one unnamed block. It must appear before
anything the project itself declares, so that a project fragment saying the
opposite wins by being read last.

# Testing

Declared first while sorting second, so the output proves the order came from
the config rather than from the directory listing.

# Conventions

Declared second while sorting first — the other half of the pair that makes the
declared order provable.
